courses.title: Start Here · German Basics

modules.description: Count, pay, give your phone number, say dates and tell the time.

modules.title: Modalverben & Trennbare Verben · Modal and Separable Verbs

modules.title: Vergangenheit · Talking About the Past
modules.description: Perfekt with haben and sein, war and hatte.
